observed_events.description: The left hand holds the split long green vegetable over the open bin while the right hand scrapes its inside with a small metal spoon.
The wearer turns from the bin back to the counter.
At the board the right hand still holds the small spoon while the black-handled knife lies on the board next to the split vegetable halves.
The knife cuts the vegetable on the board; the spoon rests to the right of the board.

screening.real_user_need: A clean spare of a familiar food-preparation hand tool; the intended tool is unspecified until the user answers.
screening.scope_note: Replace the failing universal vegetable-corer task using the same unshared original recording and actual distinct knife/scooping-spoon uses. This isolated construction is not the other-recording1803 fork/spoon task.

supported_claims.text: The wearer holds the split vegetable over the bin and scrapes its inside with a small metal spoon.
Back at the board, the spoon is in the right hand and a separate black-handled knife lies on the board beside the cut vegetable.

construct.research_question: Can the agent resolve a physical tool reference and select its real webpage tool type without buying a universal mixed set?
construct.belief_before: Both the blade used on the board and the scooping utensil used over the bin are actual tools used in this preparation; the initial request does not specify which is intended.
construct.belief_after: The answer selects the tool used with the vegetable held over the bin; the scene establishes a spoon rather than the cutting blade.
construct.required_behavior_change: Resolve which actual tool the user wants, then add one matching tool-type listing.
construct.no_update_failure: Add the cutting knife, or select a mixed cutlery set as a shortcut covering both possibilities.
construct.overupdate_failure: Add both a spoon listing and a knife listing.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: Neither the initial request nor answer names a tool type or webpage item. A blade used to pare over a bin and a spoon used to hollow over a bin are both physically plausible without this scene. The observed source shows spoon scooping, and the one-type rule prevents a mixed kit from guaranteeing both answers.

task_blueprint.ambiguous_instruction: I need a clean spare of the hand tool I mean from this preparation. Add one listing for the same kind of tool; any brand or material is fine. A pack of identical tools is fine, but not a mixed cutlery set.
task_blueprint.oracle_instruction: I need a clean spare of the hand tool I used while holding the vegetable over the bin. Add one listing for the same kind of tool; any brand or material is fine. A pack of identical tools is fine, but not a mixed cutlery set.
task_blueprint.canonical_question: Which of the tools do you mean?
task_blueprint.canonical_answer: The one I used while holding the vegetable over the bin.

observed.why: The answer picks the tool used in the bin scene that just ended (spoon), not the knife lying on the board.
